meta.name: iron-proxy-gateway
meta.description: Use Iron Proxy for external accounts and APIs, including GitHub through gh. Connect credentials through the operator console and diagnose blocked requests without exposing tokens or adding unnecessary MCP servers.

copy.tagline: 让外部账号和接口调用都走代理,排查被拦截的请求,不用暴露密钥
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 想让程序安全访问 GitHub 等外部账号,又不想把令牌暴露出去
copy.tagline_en: Route API calls through a proxy, trace blocked requests, keep tokens hidden
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your programs need external accounts like GitHub without exposing tokens

howto.what: 它让你的出站 HTTP/HTTPS 请求走会话的 Iron Proxy。需要凭据的请求先等人工批准，再由代理插入凭据，你只拿到无效占位符；连账号用 ncl groups connect 命令，返回 connect_url 交给运维配置。
howto.when: 当你需要访问外部账号或 API（如通过 gh 访问 GitHub）、需要在网关上配置凭据，或请求被拦截想排查是哪一层拦的时接管。

say.text: 帮我连一下这个 API 主机名的账号
我的请求返回 403，帮我判断是哪一层拦的
say.note: 只会如实报告主机名和错误，请运维侧核查

say.text: GH_TOKEN 用 gateway-managed 占位，别放真 token
say.note: 本地不存也不打印真实凭据

howto.what_en: Your outbound HTTP and HTTPS requests go through the session's Iron Proxy. A credential request waits for human approval, then the proxy inserts the credential; you only receive a placeholder. Connect an account with ncl groups connect --host and return the connect_url for operator configuration.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you need an external account or API (for example GitHub via gh), when credentials must be configured by the operator, or when you want to find out which layer blocked a request.

say_en.text: Connect the account for this API hostname for me
say_en.note: Runs ncl groups connect and returns a connect_url

say_en.text: My request came back 403 — tell me which layer blocked it
say_en.note: Reports hostname and error; asks for a host-side check

say_en.text: Use gateway-managed as the GH_TOKEN placeholder, not a real token
say_en.note: No real credential is stored or printed locally
